recognize_zh: 中央一顆嗜中性球的核分成兩個圓形緻密葉、中間細絲相連，呈夾鼻眼鏡狀，細胞質有正常細顆粒；成熟卻只有雙葉，是 Pelger-Huët 異常的線索。
features: Normal-sized neutrophil with bilobed, spectacle-shaped (pince-nez) nucleus
Two round, dense lobes joined by a thin bridge
Cytoplasm with normal fine neutrophilic granules
Background normochromic red cells with a few echinocytes and platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus consisting of two round dense lobes connected by a thin strand, in a pince-nez configuration. The chromatin is mature and clumped, and cytoplasmic granulation appears normal. Background red cells are normochromic with occasional echinocytes and adequate platelets. Findings are consistent with a Pelger-Huët-type neutrophil; correlation with the percentage of affected neutrophils and clinical context distinguishes inherited anomaly from pseudo-Pelger change.

ddx.vs: Acquired forms show hypogranular cytoplasm and partial involvement of neutrophils in MDS, AML, or with drugs such as mycophenolate or colchicine.
Eosinophils share the bilobed nucleus but have coarse orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm.
Band nuclei are curved and non-constricted with less condensed chromatin rather than two round lobes.
